Noto Sans SC (Simplified Chinese) — NotoSansSC-Regular.ttf / NotoSansSC-Bold.ttf

Source: https://github.com/google/fonts (ofl/notosanssc), a Google-maintained
mirror of the Noto Sans CJK project. The two files here are static Regular
(wght=400) and Bold (wght=700) instances generated from Google Fonts'
"NotoSansSC[wght].ttf" variable font using fontTools' variable font
instancer, so dompdf's font subsetter (which needs plain TrueType outline
data, not variable-font or CFF/OpenType outline data) can embed them
correctly. No glyph shapes were modified — only the variable-width axis was
resolved to two fixed weights.

'Source'. Copyright 2014-2021 Google Inc. Noto is a trademark of Google Inc.
Licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1.
Full license text: https://openfontlicense.org / https://scripts.sil.org/OFL

Bundled solely to give the PO PDF export (includes/export/po_export_pdf.php)
correct Chinese (CJK) glyph rendering in dompdf, as required by the Purchase
Order document feature.
